category_edits.rationale: Across all four datasets, jointly lower learning rate to 5e-4 and increase dropout to 0.15 to test gentler optimization with stronger regularization. Preserve architecture, loss, masking, routing, seeds and training limits. Existing predictor loading remains compatible because dropout is disabled during evaluation and checkpoint shapes are unchanged.

change_summary: Jointly set default learning rate to 5e-4 and dropout to 0.15 for all four independent BERT4Rec category models.
